summary: This specification defines a TLS handshake message for exchanging supplemental application data. Hello message extensions determine which supplemental data types both client and server support, and the new message carries the data. Other documents define the specific types. It updates RFC 4346 and was later updated by RFC 8447 and RFC 8996.

eli5.summary: When two computers set up a secure connection, they can slip in an extra envelope of useful information too. This defines the envelope and how they agree on what goes inside.
